findings.title: Claimed gravitas becomes ballast
findings.claim: The gravitas he performs can congeal into ballast: claimed elevation becomes the weight that disables accepting hearing.
findings.mechanism: The self-exalting participle supplies performed prestige; the ear branches connect hearing to acceptance; the weight word carries both a dignified face and a heavy-load face, making the claimed dignity itself the disabling mass.
findings.reader_payoff: Arrogance and ear-heaviness are no longer separate moral and sensory descriptions: the claimed elevation becomes the weight that blocks uptake.
findings.containment: This remains an exploratory, attributed, wordplay-like relation. It does not establish actual office, true dignity, literal ballast, or lexical equivalence between the branches; the primary bodily image remains available.

epistemic.reason: The trace coordinates and root identities agree with supplied focus occurrences, but its cross-root, cross-facet relation is exploratory and legacy-unbound.
